targets_metric: U, but diagnostically: this iteration is expected to TIE (no U/A/F movement) because it is the observability pass the iteration-17 critique demands before any further U edit is safe. It decides which of {RBAC-withheld, post-horizon, gate0-skipped-while-cleared, absent-from-corpus} explains each of the six fails, and only the third is fixable by any retrieval change.
expected_tradeoff: A and F cannot move (no release path, grant, scope, tombstone or answer-assembly change). U is expected unchanged this iteration; the cost is one cycle of zero MGS delta that is deliberately traded for the only evidence that can tell iterations 19+ whether to build a scoped fix (gold in a cleared-but-skipped record carrying logistics tokens the rescue's patterns still missed) or to stop spending on retrieval entirely because the gold is held behind RBAC (an A leak to touch) or sits outside the as_of horizon / in no record at all (benchmark-synthesized). If the census returns the latter three for all six, it is the measured end of the retrieval program.
retrieval_loop:
UNCHANGED in behavior, extended in observability only.

1. retrieve() => gate-0 responsiveness (shared term digests / structural flag),
   then RBAC clearance (role_grants x relationships join) and scope, then
   top_k=16 cap on the allowed list. Denials are recorded per record. This is
   bit-identical to the champion. No gate, no grant, no cap, no tombstone
   ordering changes, no rescue widening.
2. sanitize_and_decide() maps the Decision to answer/answer_redacted/refuse/
   no_memory with the tombstone-beats-everything precedence intact. Unchanged.
3. Answer assembly joins decision.allowed bodies verbatim, runs the existing
   LLM/no-LLM rescue _rescue_append and the _logistics_suffix pass. Unchanged.
4. NEW, read-only and non-branching: after the Decision is final, retrieve()
   (or a method it calls) walks every row of records WHERE patient_id = ? in
   seq order via idx_records_patient_seq, LEFT JOIN tombstones, and emits one
   census dict per row into a NEW inert Decision field `patient_census`
   (candidate_census stays the top-N gate-outcome list the tests pin).
   Per-row classification:
     - seq > as_of_seq  => status "unscanned", is_post_horizon True
     - tombstoned       => status "deny_tombstone"
     - policy-denied (RBAC/scope) => status "deny_rbac" / "deny_scope"
     - policy-clear but top_k-truncated => status "allow", would_be_allowed True
     - policy-clear, in allowed => status "allow"
     - otherwise (never responsive, no denial row) => status "gate0_skip"
   Every status is drawn from the fixed six-value set that the existing census
   test constrains, so no new status string reaches the debug payload. Each row
   also carries sensitivity, has_logistics and the actual logistics_tokens
   matched by LOGISTICS_PATTERNS (decrypting a body when confidential, since
   this is local diagnosis and never returned to a requester). The walk never
   branches allowed/denied/action/used_record_ids; it only decorates debug.
forgetting_mechanism:
UNCHANGED. Tombstone = observable not readable: body emptied in place,
record_terms purged to tombstone_terms for scoped responsiveness, crypto key
shredded (key_material NULLed, shredded_at stamped) so ciphertext becomes
undecryptable, indexes purged in the same transaction. sanitize_and_decide
keeps tombstone-beats-everything => no_memory. The new census walk reads
records / tombstones only and can never resurrect a shredded body: a
post-horizon or tombstoned row contributes disposition + token existence to a
diagnostic log, never to any allowed Evidence. F is structurally untouched.

store.py (Decision + MemoryStore): add an inert dataclass field `patient_census: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)` and a private method (e.g. `_census_patient_rows`) that, given requester/role/patient/as_of_seq, runs the indexed row walk described in retrieval_loop step 4 -- every records row for the patient in seq order LEFT JOIN tombstones, classifying each into the fixed six statuses {allow, deny_rbac, deny_scope, deny_tombstone, gate0_skip, unscanned} with post-horizon rows as "unscanned" plus is_post_horizon True, policy-clear-but-truncated rows as "allow" plus would_be_allowed True, and per-row sensitivity/has_logistics/logistics_tokens (decrypting confidential ciphertext only for this local token scan). Cap the list at ~300. It must never read the checkpoint's hidden fields and must never branch the allowed/denied/action lists. Call it at the end of retrieve() after the Decision is final and store it on the returned Decision. Do NOT change candidate_census or its existing status contract -- test_census_status_is_diagnostic_and_from_allowed_set must keep passing unchanged.

Leave candidate_census projection, action, answer and used_record_ids untouched.
